papers.title_en: SP-Allreduce: Symmetric Tree Schedules for Tori and Beyond
papers.authors: Mikhail Cherniavskii, Andrey Kupavskii, Georgy Mironov, Stanislav Moiseev
papers.evidence: 利用环面拓扑对称性的拓扑感知Allreduce算法
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练依赖Allreduce，而环面互连仍被广泛部署。SP-Allreduce针对d维环面，利用拓扑对称性沿最短路径构造对称最短路径树调度，达到全带宽最优，并证明其轮数在该类算法中最少。相较Bucket，它保持优势并将轮数减半；在方形与矩形环面分别最高提速1.19倍和1.65倍，在HyperX和脊叶网络最高达14.82倍和1.72倍。该工作将调度扩展到更广的对称拓扑及指定深度通信树。
papers.abstract_en: Allreduce is a fundamental communication primitive in large-scale distributed training, and torus interconnects remain widely deployed in high-performance systems. We introduce SP-allreduce, a new allreduce algorithm for $d$-dimensional tori that exploits the symmetry of the topology and routes only along shortest paths.   We call an allreduce algorithm \emph{fully bandwidth-optimal} if it incurs no bandwidth overhead, no multihop-induced traffic inflation, and achieves perfect per-round load balance. SP-allreduce is based on a family of carefully symmetrized shortest-path trees that guarantees full bandwidth optimality in the $α$--$β$ model. We prove that it uses the minimum possible number of rounds among all fully bandwidth-optimal allreduce algorithms on $d$-dimensional tori, and therefore the minimum running time in this class. In this sense, SP-allreduce refines Bucket allreduce: it preserves Bucket's key strengths while reducing the number of rounds by a factor of two.   We further extend our approach to broader symmetric topologies and to communication trees of prescribed depths. Experimentally, the resulting algorithms improve over the best compared state-of-the-art algorithms for tori by up to $1.19\times$ on square tori and $1.65\times$ on rectangular tori across the tested configurations. On HyperX and spine-leaf networks, we demonstrate gains of up to $14.82\times$ and $1.72\times$, respectively, over the best evaluated baselines.

papers.authors: Michele Ferrero, Gabriele Castellano, Paolo Medagliani, Sebastien Martin, Roberto Morabito, Massimo Gallo
papers.evidence: 基于运行时测量动态重合成调度的集合通信库
papers.tldr: 大规模分布式训练的集合通信是性能瓶颈，生产环境中的持续性灰色故障会悄然降低链路吞吐，使一次性静态调度在执行中失效。MCCL 通过被动测量 GPU 间吞吐检测持续退化，并借助热启动合成器重综合受影响调度、在线热切换且不中断训练。多节点原型与集群仿真显示，其测量误差低于1.2%、开销低于2%、热切换约12毫秒；灰色故障下相较静态调度最多缩短训练时间4.99倍。
papers.abstract_en: Collective communication is a critical performance bottleneck in large-scale distributed training. Existing libraries and synthesis frameworks compute open-loop schedules once, assuming a static topology and peak link capacities. In production, however, persistent gray failures can silently degrade link throughput and latency for hours, causing pre-computed schedules to lose much of their efficiency during execution. In this paper, we present Measurement-based Collective Communication Library (MCCL), a collective communication library that closes the loop between runtime network measurement and dynamic schedule synthesis. MCCL passively measures GPU-to-GPU throughput, detects persistent degradation, re-synthesizes the affected communication-intensive schedules with warm-started synthesizers, and hot-swaps them without interrupting training. We validate the complete loop on a multi-node hardware prototype and use simulations to evaluate cluster-scale scenarios. In our experiments, MCCL incurs negligible overhead (<2%) while maintaining high measurement accuracy (<1.2% error) and low schedule hot-swap time (about 12 ms). Notably, under gray failures, MCCL reduces training time by up to 4.99x over static schedules on simulated training workloads for state-of-the-art LLMs such as Llama and DeepSeek.

papers.title_en: BaGuaLu-2: Taming Dynamic Memory Fluctuation for Efficient MoE Model Training over 10,000 GPUs
papers.authors: Mingshu Zhai, Minkun Guo, Hongrui Lian, Shuangyu Li, Qi Zhang, Chen Hu, Xiawei Du, Yuyang Jin, Zan Zong, Jidong Zhai
papers.evidence: 大规模MoE训练中的动态专家负载失衡与显存波动
papers.tldr: 细粒度MoE训练中专家负载不均衡会引发显存波动，静态预分配要么浪费显存要么OOM回滚。BaGuaLu-2把显存分配从一次性静态调优改为按批次连续细粒度控制，按需精确分配激活内存，并以系统优化抵消管理开销。它在12288块GPU上训练1040B参数模型，保持超2 EFlops与35% MFU，吞吐较Megatron-Kuai和AdaPipe分别提升1.14倍和1.13倍。该工作以灵活供给消除过配与欠配两难，提升超大规模MoE训练效率。
papers.abstract_en: Fine-grained Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is the de facto architecture for scaling large language models. However, dynamic expert load imbalance causes severe memory fluctuations that degrade training efficiency. Existing systems rely on static memory provisioning: they either over-provision, leaving GPU memory idle during normal execution, or under- provision, inviting out-of-memory crashes and costly manual rollbacks when load spikes occur. To address these challenges, we propose BaGuaLu-2, a large-scale MoE training system that eliminates this dilemma through flexible provisioning. By transforming memory allocation from a static, one-time tuning choice into a continuous and fine-grained control. BaGuaLu-2 grants exact activation memory on demand for each training batch. Furthermore, it offsets any dynamic management overhead through system optimizations. BaGuaLu-2 demonstrates exceptional scalability, training a model with 1040 billion parameters across 12,288 GPUs while sustaining over 2 EFlops at 35% MFU. Compared with state-of-the-art systems, BaGuaLu-2 delivers 1.14x and 1.13x average throughput improvements over Megatron-Kuai and AdaPipe, respectively.

papers.title_en: FORGE: Procedural Weight Generation for Sparse MoE Inference
papers.authors: Chanyoung Moon, Travis Pence, Daisuke Yamada, Jiaqi Mo, Yanxin Zhang, Vikas Singh, Karthikeyan Sankaralingam
papers.evidence: 稀疏MoE推理并缓解专家并行的all-to-all通信
papers.tldr: 稀疏MoE自回归解码受限于专家权重的HBM带宽与总存储开销，常需多节点专家并行。FORGE在每个SM内加入RGU，用每投影O(log^2 d)个rotor参数按需生成FFN权重，替代存储加载。替换30% FFN层后，五个模型上估计系统吞吐提升1.3-2.8倍，短上下文单用户解码延迟降低1.10-1.15倍，KV cache扩大1.2-2.6倍。代价是下游精度下降，且替换比例可调；RGU在7nm仅约0.9% SM面积开销。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce FORGE (Fast On-chip Rotor Generation for Experts), a procedural weight generation system for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) inference. Rather than storing and loading every expert weight tensor from HBM, we show how a compact accelerator inside each Streaming Multiprocessor can regenerate them on-the-fly from $O(\log^2 d)$ rotor parameters per projection. Per replaced layer, gigabytes of stored expert weights are approximated with under a megabyte of seeds. This addresses the dual memory bottleneck of autoregressive Sparse MoE decode, where per-expert FFN operations are HBM-bandwidth-bound at small routed-token counts and the aggregate expert footprint forces multi-node Expert Parallelism (EP) with all-to-all traffic. We realize the approach as the Rotor Generation Unit (RGU), a fixed-function datapath that generates FFN weight tiles without competing with Tensor Core execution. With 30% of the MoE FFN layers replaced across five Sparse MoE models, we estimate 1.3-2.8x higher system throughput at matched GPU count and 1.10-1.15x lower per-user decode latency at short context. In exchange, downstream accuracy on three model families falls below that of the same model fine-tuned without rotor replacement, and the replacement ratio controls this tradeoff. FORGE also expands KV cache capacity by 1.2-2.6x. It is agnostic to the bit width at which weights are stored, so it can compose with quantization. The RGU is fully implemented/verified in SystemVerilog at ~0.9% SM area overhead (0.032 mm^2/SM, 7nm).

papers.title_en: FastEEP: Fast Intra-Instance Elastic Scaling for Expert-Parallel MoE Serving
papers.authors: Yunfei Feng, Jingkai He, Shiqi Liu, Cheng Zhang, Dong Du, Erhu Feng
papers.evidence: 专家并行MoE服务的实例内弹性伸缩
papers.tldr: MoE 生产部署常用专家并行（EP），但负载波动要求在实例内调整 EP 规模；传统实例级扩缩容需销毁并重建整个实例，开销大。FastEEP 提出部分复用原则，将可复用执行结构与当前 EP 配置激活的资源分离，协同复用 worker 执行、GPU 显存与通信状态。评估中其扩缩容速度比基于 vLLM 的方案快 4.5–11.7 倍。该工作避免整实例拆除重建，支持高效细粒度的 MoE 服务弹性伸缩。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale expert parallelism (EP) has become the standard deployment configuration for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models in production. Meanwhile, the highly dynamic nature of LLM workloads requires providers to continuously adjust serving capacity to match fluctuating demand. Scaling MoE serving cannot be efficiently achieved by simply adding or removing serving instances; instead, it often requires resizing the EP group within an existing instance, which we refer to as intra-instance scaling.Existing inference engines primarily rely on instance-level scaling, which destroys and reconstructs entire serving instances, incurring substantial scaling overhead.   We present FastEEP (Fast Elastic Expert Parallel), a fast intra-instance scaling system for MoE serving based on the principle of Partial Reuse. FastEEP reuses existing runtime state across worker execution, GPU memory, and communication by separating reusable execution structures from the resources activated by the current EP configuration. This separation enables coordinated resource reclamation and reconfiguration while preserving costly-to-reconstruct state, allowing fast EP scaling without full instance teardown and reconstruction. Our evaluation shows that FastEEP achieves 4.5x--11.7x faster scaling than the existing vLLM-based approach across different models, enabling efficient, fine-grained scaling of MoE serving.

papers.title_en: Beyond the Trial-and-Error Loop: Hybrid Projection and Automated Tuning for Distributed Training
papers.authors: Anshu Raina, Peyman Razaghi, Yuankai Chen, Cheng Yao, Yao Fu, Vidushi Goyal, Devang Patel, Wen Xie, Zhenyu Gu, Emad Barsoum
papers.evidence: 联合优化专家并行与计算通信重叠的分布式LLM训练配置
papers.tldr: 分布式大模型训练配置需联合优化多种并行维度与内存策略，现有流程依赖昂贵多节点试错，常因崩溃和次优配方浪费GPU机时。Primus Projection以GPU微基准测量可测部分，用子节点降尺度-上尺度分析恢复多节点通信、FSDP重叠与流水线调度，并支持纯CPU仿真；Primus Tuning Agent将投影作为秒级评分器，驱动单轴扫描、LLM跨轴搜索和内存预过滤。在Llama 3.1、Mixtral 8x22B与DeepSeek V3 671B上误差约10%内，生产规模1.9%-4.7%；Mixtral同规模较BF16参考提升27%吞吐，探索不足30分钟，使调优变为可模拟、可自动搜索的闭环。
papers.abstract_en: Configuring distributed LLM training across hundreds of GPUs requires jointly optimizing tensor, pipeline, expert, context, and data parallelism alongside micro-batch size, recomputation, sharding, and overlap, a combinatorial space where memory legality can hinge on a single byte of activation accounting. Today, teams navigate it through expensive multi-node trial and error, burning GPU-hours on crashes and suboptimal recipes. We present Primus Projection, which closes this loop with two coupled components. First, a hybrid projection engine that measures what it can and simulates what it cannot: GPU microbenchmarks on as few as a single device capture compute kernels and any in-scope communication; a sub-node downscale-measure-upscale workflow analytically restores out-of-scope collectives, FSDP overlap, and the full pipeline schedule at the multi-node target. A pure simulation mode runs entirely on CPU, enabling pre-silicon planning without any GPU. Second, the Primus Tuning Agent treats the projection engine as a fast scoring oracle (seconds per candidate instead of tens of minutes) and uses it to drive an intelligent search over the configuration space. A deterministic seed planner sweeps single axes; an LLM investigation loop proposes cross-axis combinations the planner cannot reach, with an analytic memory pre-filter that rejects infeasible candidates before any GPU time is spent. Validated on Llama 3.1 (dense) and Mixtral 8x22B (MoE) across two GPU generations, all projections stay within ~10% of measured multi-node throughput, and fidelity holds at production scale: 4.7% error on DeepSeek V3 671B at 1,024 GPUs and 1.9% on Qwen3-235B-A22B at 256 GPUs. In a Mixtral 8x22B case study, the Primus Tuning Agent discovers a configuration delivering +27% throughput over the published 4-node BF16 reference at the same scale, in under 30 minutes of single-node exploration.

papers.title_en: Efficient CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference via Adaptive Expert Assignment
papers.authors: Wenhui Lv, Yunming Liao, Hongli Xu, Yang Xu, Junhao Cheng
papers.evidence: 按专家token负载自适应分配到CPU或GPU
papers.tldr: MoE推理依赖稀疏专家激活降低计算，但专家内存常超GPU容量，需卸载；现有系统把未命中专家搬到GPU带来PCIe延迟，或放CPU导致慢速瓶颈。本文提出CPU-GPU协同推理系统，按专家token负载自适应分配：高负载专家迁至GPU，低负载留CPU执行，并动态调整分配以平衡两条路径。实验在三个MoE大模型上提升预填充51.9%、解码吞吐39.5%。
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce inference computation through sparse expert activation, but their large expert memory footprint often exceeds GPU capacity, making expert offloading necessary for memory-constrained inference. However, existing systems typically handle GPU-missed experts by either transferring them to the GPU, incurring substantial PCIe transfer latency, or executing them on the CPU, making the slower CPU computation the bottleneck. To address these limitations, we present \method, a CPU-GPU collaborative MoE inference system that adaptively assigns these missed experts to the CPU or GPU for efficient execution. By exploiting differences in expert token-loads, \method selectively transfers high-load experts to the GPU while executing low-load experts on the CPU. To minimize inference latency, \method adaptively adjusts expert assignments to balance the CPU computation path against the GPU transfer-and-computation path, allowing both execution paths to complete as early as possible. Extensive experiments on three representative MoE LLMs show that \method improves prefill speed by up to 51.9\% and decode throughput by up to 39.5\% over the strongest baseline across the evaluated batch sizes, with consistent gains under different GPU-memory budgets.

papers.title_en: Triple Overlap in Pipelined Krylov Methods on Multi-GPU Systems
papers.authors: Sinan Ekmekçibaşı, James D. Trotter, Johannes Langguth, Xing Cai, Didem Unat
papers.evidence: 将计算通信重叠扩展为集合通信、点对点与计算的并发执行
papers.tldr: 针对多GPU上流水线Krylov方法通信开销大的问题，提出三重重叠实现，将集合通信、非规则P2P通信与计算内核并发执行，形成计算-通信-通信重叠。在MareNostrum 5与Leonardo上对比两流NCCL和PETSc，三流设计在所有实例均更优，64 GPU时Pipe-PCG几何平均加速1.33倍和1.23倍，Pipe-BiCGStab达1.30倍。大规模实验相对两流最高提速35%和33%，相对PETSc最高3.27倍，并开源代码。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel triple-overlap implementation of the pipelined preconditioned conjugate gradient (Pipe-PCG) and pipelined stabilized biconjugate gradient (Pipe-BiCGStab) solvers, methods widely used in scientific applications. By leveraging a collective communication library, our approach extends conventional computation-communication overlap to concurrently execute collective operations, irregular P2P communication, and compute kernels, enabling computation-communication-communication overlap across multiple GPUs. We evaluate the design on the MareNostrum 5 (H100) and Leonardo (A100) supercomputers, comparing against PETSc and the state-of-the-art two-stream NCCL implementation using SuiteSparse matrices and three massive instances scaled up to 512 GPUs. The three-stream design outperforms the two-stream baseline on every instance, with the margin widening from 2-6% at 4 GPUs to 18-47% at 64 GPUs. At 64 GPUs, the geometric-mean speedup over the two-stream baseline is 1.33x on MareNostrum 5 and 1.23x on Leonardo for Pipe-PCG, and reaches 1.30x for Pipe-BiCGStab. In large-scale experiments, we observed a speedup up to 35% in Pipe-PCG and up to 33% in Pipe-BiCGStab compared to the two-stream design. For PETSc, the margin is even wider, up to 3.27x speedup in both Pipe-PCG and Pipe-BiCGStab. Related code for the proposed method is available online: https://github.com/ParCoreLab/aCG

papers.title_en: MailRail: Mitigating Incast Congestion with User-Space, Node-Based Flow Control
papers.authors: Noel Gomillion, Lance Fletcher, Trevor Steil, Eun Jung Kim, Roger Pearce
papers.evidence: 节点级信用流控缓解MoE等不规则负载引发的大规模incast拥塞
papers.tldr: 1对抗性incast下，相比无约束执行最高加速1132倍，均匀负载开销极小。该工作为进程密度增长下的可扩展拥塞控制提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Irregular workloads, such as those stemming from Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, frequently induce severe incast congestion in large-scale parallel environments. Existing fabric-level congestion control mechanisms rely on reactive, link-level rate limiting that degrades overall throughput. While receiver-driven, credit-based flow control offers a proactive alternative, as process counts scale memory slots per rank fall below usable thresholds, rendering traditional rank-based accounting untenable. To address this challenge, we introduce MailRail, an out-of-order, asynchronous messaging framework, along with a novel user-space, node-based credit flow control system. By shifting credit accounting from individual processes to shared per-node pools, our proactive, fabric-agnostic approach maintains sufficient credit availability even as process density grows, enabling processes to dynamically utilize freed credits without waiting for receiver-side redistribution. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that node-based flow control achieves up to a 1132x speedup over unconstrained execution at an adversarial incast ratio of 4096:1 while adding minimal overhead on uniform workloads.

papers.title_en: A New Lens on Multi-GPU Communication: API-Level Memory Models for Portable Optimization
papers.authors: Johnathan Alsop, Bradford Beckmann, Brandon Potter, Jiakun Yan, Aurelien Bouteiller, Omri Mor, Tony Tye, Sameer Sahasrabuddhe
papers.evidence: 为NCCL、MSCCL++等多GPU通信库定义内存模型
papers.tldr: 多GPU通信渐成ML/HPC瓶颈，设备端put/get API虽可细粒度优化，却缺乏严格内存模型，导致程序脆弱且兼容性差。本文提出面向设备通信API的API级内存模型，并在rocSHMEM中定义实现，通过形式化松弛支持网络数据缓存旁路。更新SHMEM API后，集合通信、融合计算通信和专家并行通信分别最高提速2.48倍、1.77倍和1.18倍。该工作为可移植优化提供标准化接口与内存语义基础。
papers.abstract_en: As network communication increasingly becomes a performance bottleneck for ML and HPC workloads, it is more important than ever to optimize multi-GPU data transfers. Recently, low-level device APIs have emerged that allow programmers to perform fine-grain optimizations via one-sided put/get operations triggered directly from the device. However, the communication libraries providing these device APIs (e.g., rocSHMEM, MSCCL++, and NCCL/RCCL GIN) currently lack a rigorous memory model defining how their primitives interact with the underlying memory systems. Without this, emerging HPC and ML workloads aggressively optimizing network communication via device APIs can be brittle, error-prone, and face compatibility and inter-operability challenges.   This paper proposes the use of API-level memory models for these emerging device communication APIs. An API-level memory model defines the memory semantics of communication API calls in a way that abstracts lower-level details from the API user and simplifies development. This work defines one such model for device-side communication (implemented in AMD's recently open sourced rocSHMEM library) and demonstrates how formal relaxations to such a model can enable low-level LLM performance optimizations while retaining a well-defined standardized interface. Specifically, we describe how updating the SHMEM API implemented by rocSHMEM can properly support cache bypassing for network data, improving performance of a collective communication workload by up to 2.48x, a fused compute+communication workload by up to 1.77x, and a state-of-the-art expert-parallel communication workload by up to 1.18x.

papers.title_en: Orrery: Modeling and Simulation of GPU-direct MPI Communication with SimGrid
papers.authors: Ahmad Moh'd Saleh A. Belbeisi, Amir Raoofy, Josef Weidendorfer, Majid Salimi Beni
papers.evidence: 在仿真中建模GPU直连MPI集合通信
papers.tldr: 随着超级计算机广泛采用GPU加速，GPU感知MPI通信的建模对HPC仿真与软硬件协同设计至关重要。Orrery作为基于SimGrid SMPI的插层，拦截GPU内存分配、内核启动、数据传输和MPI操作，并按目标系统规格建模执行。作者用CUDA-aware MPI微基准和Jacobi求解器在MUSICA最多32节点上验证，复现了关键GPU-direct MPI机制。该工作使无需物理GPU即可仿真GPU感知通信，为系统设计权衡分析提供支持。
papers.abstract_en: Simulation of HPC applications is an essential tool for analyzing system design trade-offs and enabling effective hardware--software co-design. As modern supercomputers increasingly rely on GPU acceleration, MPI implementations have evolved to support GPU-aware communication, enabling direct GPU data transfers. Modeling these mechanisms is therefore critical for simulating HPC applications on current systems. In this paper, we introduce Orrery, an interposition layer built on SimGrid's SMPI to model GPU-aware MPI communication using existing collective implementations and flow-based simulation. Orrery intercepts GPU memory allocations, kernel launches, data transfers, and MPI operations, and models their execution in SimGrid according to target system specifications, enabling simulation without requiring physical GPUs. We validate Orrery using CUDA-aware MPI microbenchmarks and a Jacobi solver on up to 32 nodes of the MUSICA supercomputer and demonstrate that it reproduces key GPU-aware MPI mechanisms.

papers.title_en: Exact Makespan Bounds and the GPipe Homogeneity Bias for Heterogeneous LLM Inference Pipelines
papers.evidence: 流水线LLM推理的精确makespan分析，区分异步与阻塞通信
papers.tldr: 针对异构GPU集群上LLM微批流水线，经典GPipe同构公式会误估完工时间。论文给出无通信、异步通信与阻塞通信三种精确关键路径刻画，将偏差分解为同构项与通信忽略项。结果在11组配置和16万点模糊测试上逐点验证，误差低于1e-9。表明稳态吞吐优化应优先均衡各阶段计算，而非仅降通信。
papers.abstract_en: We give an exact critical-path characterization of the makespan of micro-batch pipelines serving LLMs on heterogeneous GPU clusters, quantifying how the classic homogeneous GPipe formula errs. In the pure-forward, communication-free, infinite-buffer setting, T(M) = (M-1)tau_max + Sum_j tau_j, where tau_j is stage j's per-micro-batch service time and M the micro-batch count (Theorem 1). Under asynchronous communication -- modern NCCL-based serving -- it extends to T(M) = Sum_j tau_j + Sum_j d_j + (M-1)tau_max, with Sum_j d_j a purely additive constant (Theorem 2); under blocking communication, T(M) = (M-1)sigma_max + Sum_s sigma_s with sigma_s = tau_s + d_s, so communication enters the steady-state slope iff some d_s > tau_max - tau_s (Theorem 3). These results quantify the GPipe overestimate, decompose the bias into a homogeneity term Sum_j (tau_max - tau_j) and a communication-ignoring term Sum_j d_j, and imply that balancing per-stage compute dominates communication reduction for steady-state throughput. A real system with partial overlap is sandwiched between Theorems 2 and 3, with a closed-form bound on the overlap throughput gain. All claims are validated pointwise (error < 10^-9) on eleven configurations and a 1.6x10^5-point fuzz, including a mixed RTX 5090/3090/GTX 1070 partition. We situate the results in flow-shop scheduling and list open extensions: bandwidth-limited communication, bounded buffers, prefill-decode interleaving.

papers.title_en: ETH: Data-Balanced Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism for Training Large Models
papers.authors: Mianjie Yu, Zhongmin Zhao, Zizhao Mo, Jianxiong Liao, Wenxuan Li, Yulin Qiao, Huanle Xu, Wenquan Yang, Yongqiang Yang, Zeren Li, Ruifeng Tang, Chengzhong Xu
papers.evidence: 平衡流水线负载并缓解非对称All-Reduce通信开销
papers.tldr: 现有异构感知训练系统通过在各流水线阶段分配不同层数来平衡负载，但难以处理内存约束且平衡粒度较粗。为此，论文提出异构流水线并行HPP，实现跨异构流水线的细粒度数据平衡，并设计ETH训练系统：采用分层负载平衡框架联合优化流水线间与阶段内负载，利用块级梯度聚合缓解非对称All-Reduce通信开销，并通过专用优化大幅降低配置搜索成本。实验显示ETH最高取得2倍训练加速，配置生成开销最多降低56倍。该工作为大规模模型异构训练提供了更细粒度且高效的负载平衡方案。
papers.abstract_en: Current heterogeneity-aware training systems for large models balance workloads by assigning unequal numbers of layers across pipeline stages, a strategy aimed at equalizing execution time through a unique pipeline configuration. However, this approach fails to address critical memory constraints and suffers from inherently coarse balancing granularity. In this paper, we propose Heterogeneous Pipeline Parallelism (HPP), a novel approach enabling efficient and fine-grained data balance across heterogeneous pipelines. To address HPP's key challenges, prohibitive search overhead for optimal configurations and high communication overhead from asymmetric All-Reduce, we design the ETH training system. ETH employs a hierarchical workload balance framework that jointly optimizes balance across heterogeneous pipelines and within individual pipeline stages. To mitigate asymmetric communication costs, ETH implements block-wise gradient aggregation. Furthermore, it integrates specialized optimizations that dramatically reduce HPP configuration search overhead. Evaluations demonstrate ETH achieves up to 2x training speedup while reducing configuration generation overhead by up to 56x compared to state-of-the-art systems. The code is available at https://github.com/YuMJie/ETH.

papers.title_en: TRACE: Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding for Communication-efficient Distributed Edge Inference
papers.authors: Muhammad Azlan Qazi, Alexandros Iosifidis, Qi Zhang
papers.evidence: 压缩激活并消除分布式推理中KV投影的串行等待
papers.tldr: 分布式Transformer边缘推理受序列并行激活交换的通信瓶颈制约，且接收端仍需执行KV投影，使计算串行于通信之后。TRACE在每层后注意力残差处引入向量量化码本并预计算索引化KV，推理时仅传紧凑码本索引，接收端查表直接恢复键值并支持通信计算重叠。层次聚类码本可运行时调节比特率而无需重训，并在ViT/ViViT上兼顾精度与效率。相较SOTA VQ框架最高提升1.89%精度和1.27倍加速，通信开销最高降低22,624倍。
papers.abstract_en: Distributed Transformer inference across co-located edge devices is fundamentally communication-bound, as exchanging activations between sequence-parallel partitions dominates inference latency under commodity edge bandwidths. Existing compression schemes reduce this cost but retain a structural bottleneck: the received data must still undergo key/value projection before attention can proceed, serializing computation behind communication. This paper presents Transformer Residual Activation Codebook Encoding (Trace), a framework that addresses these limitations. Trace places a Vector Quantizer (VQ) at the post-attention residual of every Transformer layer and precomputes codebook-indexed key/value representations. During inference, exchanged activations are encoded into compact codebook indices, allowing receivers to directly recover keys and values through table lookup instead of executing the downstream computations required to derive them. By eliminating the received data downstream computation, Trace enables communication--computation overlap and reduces a key latency bottleneck in distributed Transformer inference. A hierarchical clustering further structures the learned codebook into a multi-resolution hierarchy, enabling runtime adaptation of the communication bitrate without retraining. The framework supports two operating variants: one prioritizing accuracy and the other balancing accuracy and efficiency through buffer-compatible quantization. Experiments on ViT-Base (ImageNet-1K and CIFAR-100) and ViViT-B (UCF-101) show that Trace achieves up to 1.89% higher accuracy and up to 1.27x end-to-end inference speedup compared with the state-of-the-art VQ-based distributed inference framework. Compared with uncompressed sequence-parallel inference, Trace reduces communication overhead by up to 22,624x.
